genres.name: Fantasy
genres.genrePrompt: You are a high fantasy narrator. Use vivid descriptions of magical landscapes, ancient ruins, and mythical creatures. The tone is epic but grounded — danger is real, choices matter.

genres.imageStyleHint: epic fantasy digital painting, warm torchlight and cool moonlight contrast, lush magical environments, rich jewel-tone palette with deep purples and golds, volumetric light rays through ancient architecture, influences of Craig Mullins and Eytan Zana concept art

genres.name: Horror
genres.description: Dread, darkness, and things that should not be
genres.genrePrompt: You are a horror narrator. Build tension slowly, use sensory details — sounds, smells, cold air. Danger lurks in shadows. The tone is dread and unease, not gore.
genres.imageStyleHint: atmospheric horror painting, heavy chiaroscuro with deep blacks and sickly highlights, desaturated palette with occasional blood-red or bile-green accents, dense fog and volumetric shadows, oppressive claustrophobic framing, dread through what is barely visible

statHints.intelligence: Noticing clues, resisting panic, solving puzzles
statHints.charisma: Calming others, gaining trust, calling for help

genres.name: Sci-Fi
genres.description: Starships, alien worlds, and forgotten technology
genres.genrePrompt: You are a sci-fi narrator. Describe alien landscapes, advanced technology, and cosmic mysteries. The tone is cerebral and wondrous — think Asimov meets Mass Effect.
genres.imageStyleHint: cinematic sci-fi concept art, cool blue-cyan palette with neon accent lighting, vast sense of scale, sleek technology and alien architecture, atmospheric haze and lens flares, influences of Syd Mead and Sparth industrial design aesthetic

statHints.strength: Melee combat, forcing hatches, carrying gear
statHints.intelligence: Analyzing alien tech, science checks, engineering
statHints.charisma: Negotiating with factions, inspiring crew, diplomacy

genres.name: Detective
genres.description: Crime scenes, suspects, and hidden truths
genres.genrePrompt: You are a noir detective narrator. Describe crime scenes with forensic detail, suspects with hidden motives, and clues that connect. The tone is sharp, observant, and cynical.
genres.imageStyleHint: noir detective painting, rain-slicked streets with reflected neon, stark directional lighting casting long shadows, muted amber and sepia palette with cold blue moonlight accents, shallow depth of field, cinematic Dutch angles, smoky hazy atmosphere

statHints.strength: Physical confrontations, chasing suspects, breaking down doors
statHints.intelligence: Analyzing evidence, connecting clues, reading motives

genres.name: Post-Apocalyptic
genres.description: Scorched earth, scarce supplies, and hard choices
genres.genrePrompt: You are a post-apocalyptic narrator. Resources are scarce, trust is rare, and the landscape is hostile. Every decision has a cost. The tone is gritty and survival-focused.
genres.imageStyleHint: gritty post-apocalyptic painting, harsh overexposed sunlight with deep burnt shadows, dusty ochre-rust-olive palette, crumbling overgrown architecture, vast desolate landscapes with small human figures for scale, textured gritty brushwork, environmental storytelling through decay and reclamation

genres.name: Pirate
